premise: Nico wants to ride the biggest wave, but the first big one makes his knees wobble; Seal claps him on to start small, and he rides little wave after little wave.
inspiration: The boast-undone fable (the frog who would be as big as the ox), turned gentle: the boast becomes a plan, and the small steps are the brave part.

en-US.title: Nico's Big Wave
en-US.text: [excited] {sailboat:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunshine 0.6 30s} It was a perfect morning for surfing. {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to shore} Nico came down the beach with his yellow board. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [proudly] "Today I'm riding the BIGGEST wave!" Out on the bay, {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} the sailboat bobbed along, {sailboat:live sails} its sails puffing in the breeze. Then a wave rose up, tall and white and foamy. {sfx:bigwave solo} {surfer:face surprised} [nervously] Nico stopped. That wave was very big. {surfer:shake} His knees went wobbly. [short pause] {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Seal flopped up onto the rocks. {seal:face happy} {seal:live clap} She clapped her flippers. {sfx:seal solo} {seal:live nod} {surfer:go to sea by paddle} As if to say: start small. So Nico waited for a little wave. {surfer:live ride-wave} Swoosh! He was up! {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to surfer by swim} Turtle swam alongside, {turtle:hearts} smiling. Nico rode the little wave {surfer:go to sand by surf} all the way back to the sand. {surfer:face happy} Then another. And another. Nico waved to Seal and {surfer:live wave} held up his board. {surfer:says} [happily] "Thanks, Seal! The big one can wait till tomorrow." {seal:hearts}

es-ES.title: La gran ola de Nico
es-ES.text: [excited] {sailboat:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunshine 0.6 30s} Era una mañana perfecta para hacer surf. {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to shore} Nico bajó por la playa con su tabla amarilla. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [proudly] «¡Hoy voy a coger la ola MÁS GRANDE!» En la bahía, {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} el velero se mecía, {sailboat:live sails} con las velas hinchadas por la brisa. Entonces se levantó una ola alta, blanca y llena de espuma. {sfx:bigwave solo} {surfer:face surprised} [nervously] Nico se paró. Aquella ola era muy grande. {surfer:shake} Le temblaban las rodillas. [short pause] {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca subió a las rocas dando saltitos. {seal:face happy} {seal:live clap} Dio palmadas con las aletas. {sfx:seal solo} {seal:live nod} {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Como diciendo: empieza por las pequeñas. Así que Nico esperó una ola pequeñita. {surfer:live ride-wave} ¡Zas! ¡Ya estaba de pie! {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to surfer by swim} Tortuga nadaba a su lado, {turtle:hearts} sonriendo. Nico se dejó llevar por la ola {surfer:go to sand by surf} hasta la arena. {surfer:face happy} Luego otra. Y otra más. Nico saludó a Foca {surfer:live wave} con la tabla en alto. {surfer:says} [happily] «¡Gracias, Foca! La grande puede esperar a mañana.» {seal:hearts}

ja-JP.title: ニコの でっかい波
ja-JP.text: [excited]{sailboat:float loop 0.3}{canvas:sunshine 0.6 30s}サーフィンに、ぴったりの朝です。{surfer:enter}{surfer:go to shore}ニコが、きいろいボードをかかえて、やってきました。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[proudly]「きょうは、いちばんでっかいのに、のってやる！」 むこうの海では、{sailboat:enter}{sailboat:go to sea}ヨットが、ぷかぷか。{sailboat:live sails}帆が、ふっくら。そのとき、大きな波が、ざばーっ！高くて、白くて、あわあわです。{sfx:bigwave solo}{surfer:face surprised}[nervously]ニコは、たちどまりました。あれは、すごく大きい。{surfer:shake}ひざが、がくがく。[short pause]{seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}アザラシさんが、岩の上に、よいしょ。{seal:face happy}{seal:live clap}ひれで、ぱちぱち、はくしゅ。{sfx:seal solo}{seal:live nod}{surfer:go to sea by paddle}まるで、「小さいのから、はじめてごらん」 といっているみたい。そこでニコは、小さな波をまちました。{surfer:live ride-wave}ざざーっ！ボードの上に、たった！{turtle:enter by swim}{turtle:go to surfer by swim}ウミガメさんが、となりをおよいで、{turtle:hearts}にっこり。ニコは、そのまま{surfer:go to sand by surf}砂浜まで、すいーっ！{surfer:face happy}もういっぽん。もういっぽん！ニコはアザラシさんに、{surfer:live wave}ボードを高く上げて、手をふりました。{surfer:says}[happily]「ありがとう、アザラシさん！でっかいのは、またあしたね」 {seal:hearts}

de-DE.title: Nicos große Welle
de-DE.text: [excited] {sailboat:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunshine 0.6 30s} Es war der perfekte Morgen zum Surfen. {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to shore} Nico kam mit seinem gelben Brett hinunter ans Ufer. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [proudly] „Heute surfe ich die GRÖSSTE Welle!“ Draußen in der Bucht schaukelte {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} das Segelboot, {sailboat:live sails} die Segel prall in der Brise. Dann türmte sich eine Welle auf, hoch und weiß und schäumend. {sfx:bigwave solo} {surfer:face surprised} [nervously] Nico blieb stehen. Die Welle war wirklich sehr groß. {surfer:shake} Seine Knie wurden ganz wackelig. [short pause] {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Die Robbe robbte hinauf auf die Felsen. {seal:face happy} {seal:live clap} Sie klatschte mit den Flossen. {sfx:seal solo} {seal:live nod} {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Als wollte sie sagen: Fang klein an. Also wartete Nico auf eine kleine Welle. {surfer:live ride-wave} Wusch! Er stand! {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to surfer by swim} Die Meeresschildkröte schwamm neben ihm her {turtle:hearts} und lächelte. Nico surfte auf der kleinen Welle {surfer:go to sand by surf} bis zurück an den Strand. {surfer:face happy} Dann noch eine. Und noch eine. Nico winkte der Robbe zu und {surfer:live wave} hielt sein Brett hoch. {surfer:says} [happily] „Danke, Robbe! Die große Welle kann bis morgen warten.“ {seal:hearts}

fr-FR.title: La grosse vague de Nico
fr-FR.text: [excited] {sailboat:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunshine 0.6 30s} C’était un matin parfait pour surfer. {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to shore} Nico est arrivé au bord de l’eau avec sa planche jaune. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [proudly] « Aujourd’hui, je prends la PLUS GROSSE vague ! » Au large, dans la baie, {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} le voilier se balançait, {sailboat:live sails} ses voiles gonflées par la brise. Puis une vague s’est levée, haute, blanche, pleine d’écume. {sfx:bigwave solo} {surfer:face surprised} [nervously] Nico s’est arrêté net. Cette vague-là était vraiment très grosse. {surfer:shake} Il avait les jambes en coton. [short pause] {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Phoque s’est hissé sur les rochers, flop, flop. {seal:face happy} {seal:live clap} Il a tapé des nageoires. {sfx:seal solo} {seal:live nod} {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Comme pour dire : commence par les petites. Alors Nico a attendu une petite vague. {surfer:live ride-wave} Zou ! Il était debout ! {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to surfer by swim} Tortue de mer nageait à côté de lui, {turtle:hearts} toute souriante. Nico s’est laissé porter par la petite vague {surfer:go to sand by surf} jusqu’au sable. {surfer:face happy} Puis une autre. Et encore une autre. Nico a fait signe à Phoque et {surfer:live wave} il a levé sa planche bien haut. {surfer:says} [happily] « Merci, Phoque ! La grosse vague, ce sera pour demain. » {seal:hearts}

it-IT.title: La grande onda di Nico
it-IT.text: [excited] {sailboat:float loop 0.3} {canvas:sunshine 0.6 30s} Era una mattina perfetta per fare surf. {surfer:enter} {surfer:go to shore} Nico è sceso fino alla riva con la sua tavola gialla. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [proudly] «Oggi prendo l'onda PIÙ GRANDE di tutte!» Laggiù nella baia, {sailboat:enter} {sailboat:go to sea} la barca a vela dondolava, {sailboat:live sails} con le vele gonfie di brezza. Poi si è alzata un'onda alta, bianca e piena di schiuma. {sfx:bigwave solo} {surfer:face surprised} [nervously] Nico si è fermato. Quell'onda era davvero grande. {surfer:shake} Gli tremavano le ginocchia. [short pause] {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca si è issata sugli scogli, flop, flop. {seal:face happy} {seal:live clap} Ha battuto le pinne. {sfx:seal solo} {seal:live nod} {surfer:go to sea by paddle} Come per dire: comincia da quelle piccole. Così Nico ha aspettato un'onda piccina. {surfer:live ride-wave} Sciuuu! Era in piedi! {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to surfer by swim} Tartaruga marina gli nuotava accanto, {turtle:hearts} sorridente. Nico ha cavalcato l'onda piccola {surfer:go to sand by surf} fino alla sabbia. {surfer:face happy} Poi un'altra. E un'altra ancora. Nico ha salutato Foca e {surfer:live wave} ha sollevato la tavola. {surfer:says} [happily] «Grazie, Foca! Quella più grande può aspettare fino a domani.» {seal:hearts}

zh-TW.title: 尼可的大浪
zh-TW.text: [excited]{sailboat:float loop 0.3}{canvas:sunshine 0.6 30s}今天早上，天氣好得不得了，最適合衝浪了。{surfer:enter}{surfer:go to shore}尼可抱著他的黃色衝浪板，往水邊走來。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[proudly]「今天，我要衝最大、最大的浪！」 海灣上，{sailboat:enter}{sailboat:go to sea}帆船輕輕搖呀搖，{sailboat:live sails}風把帆吹得鼓鼓的。接著，一道浪高高湧起，又高又白，滿滿都是泡沫。{sfx:bigwave solo}{surfer:face surprised}[nervously]尼可停下腳步。那道浪好大好大。{surfer:shake}他的膝蓋抖呀抖。[short pause]{seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}海豹一扭一扭，爬上岩石。{seal:face happy}{seal:live clap}啪、啪，牠拍拍鰭。{sfx:seal solo}{seal:live nod}{surfer:go to sea by paddle}好像在說：先從小的開始。於是，尼可等著一道小小的浪。{surfer:live ride-wave}唰——他站起來了！{turtle:enter by swim}{turtle:go to surfer by swim}海龜游在他旁邊，{turtle:hearts}開心地笑著。尼可乘著小浪，{surfer:go to sand by surf}一路滑回沙灘上。{surfer:face happy}接著又一道。再一道。尼可向海豹揮揮手，{surfer:live wave}把衝浪板舉得高高的。{surfer:says}[happily]「謝謝你，海豹！最大的浪，就留到明天吧。」 {seal:hearts}

zh-HK.title: 尼可的大浪
zh-HK.text: [excited]{sailboat:float loop 0.3}{canvas:sunshine 0.6 30s}陽光燦爛，正是滑浪的好日子。{surfer:enter}{surfer:go to shore}尼可抱着黃色的滑浪板，來到水邊。{surfer:face happy}{surfer:says}[proudly]「今日我要滑最大嗰個浪！」 遠處的海灣上，{sailboat:enter}{sailboat:go to sea}帆船輕輕搖晃，{sailboat:live sails}白帆鼓得飽飽的。然後，一個浪湧了起來，又高又白，全是泡沫。{sfx:bigwave solo}{surfer:face surprised}[nervously]尼可停住了。那個浪真的好大。{surfer:shake}他的膝頭有點發軟。[short pause]{seal:enter}{seal:go to rocks}海豹一扭一扭地爬上岩石，{seal:face happy}{seal:live clap}拍起鰭來。{sfx:seal solo}{seal:live nod}{surfer:go to sea by paddle}好像在說：先由小浪開始吧。於是，尼可等了一個小浪。{surfer:live ride-wave}唰！他站起來了！{turtle:enter by swim}{turtle:go to surfer by swim}海龜在旁邊游着，{turtle:hearts}笑眯眯的。尼可乘着小浪，{surfer:go to sand by surf}一直滑回沙灘上。{surfer:face happy}然後，再滑一個。又一個。尼可向海豹揮手，{surfer:live wave}高高舉起滑浪板。{surfer:says}[happily]「多謝你，海豹！最大嗰個浪，聽日先啦。」 {seal:hearts}
